verdict.rationale: The SDK writes session transcripts to local disk automatically and offers a SessionStore adapter to mirror them to your own object store, key-value store, or database. Agent configuration lives in plain filesystem artifacts (CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md), so user data stays under your control. However, no export feature, format specification, or exit guide is documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that transcripts use an open, documented format; a dedicated 'export all data' workflow; and independent or hands-on confirmation that data can be fully extracted and reused outside Claude.
